properties.comment:
PREDISPATCHINTERCONNECTORRES records Interconnector flows and losses for the periods calculated in each predispatch run. Only binding and interconnector constraints are reported.
Some fields are for the Frequency Controlled Ancillary Services export and import limits and extra reporting of the generic constraint setting the energy import and export limits.

fields.doc: Unique identifier of predispatch run in the form YYYYMMDDPP with 01 at 04:30
fields.name: PREDISPATCHSEQNO

fields.doc: SPD Predispatch run no, typically 1. It increments if the case is re-run.
fields.name: RUNNO

fields.doc: Interconnector identifier
fields.name: INTERCONNECTORID

fields.doc: PERIODID is just a period count, starting from 1 for each predispatch run. Use DATETIME to determine half hour period.
fields.name: PERIODID

fields.doc: Flag to indicate if this result set was sourced from the pricing run (INTERVENTION=0) or the physical run (INTERVENTION=1). In the event that there is not intervention in the market, both pricing and physical runs correspond to INTERVENTION=0
fields.name: INTERVENTION

fields.doc: Metered MW Flow from EMS. For periods subsequent to the first period of a Pre-Dispatch run, this value represents the cleared target for the previous period of that Pre-Dispatch run.
fields.name: METEREDMWFLOW

fields.doc: Calculated MW Flow
fields.name: MWFLOW

fields.doc: Calculated MW Losses
fields.name: MWLOSSES

fields.doc: $ Marginal value of interconnector constraint from SPD
fields.name: MARGINALVALUE

fields.doc: Degree of violation of interconnector constraint in MW
fields.name: VIOLATIONDEGREE

fields.doc: Last changed.
fields.name: LASTCHANGED

fields.doc: Period date and time
fields.name: DATETIME

fields.doc: Calculated export limit.
fields.name: EXPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Calculated import limit.
fields.name: IMPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Marginal loss factor. Use this to adjust bids between reports.
fields.name: MARGINALLOSS

fields.doc: Generic Constraint setting the export limit
fields.name: EXPORTGENCONID

fields.doc: Generic Constraint setting the import limit
fields.name: IMPORTGENCONID

fields.doc: Calculated export limit applying to energy + FCAS.
fields.name: FCASEXPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Calculated import limit applying to energy + FCAS.
fields.name: FCASIMPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Aggregate Constraint contribution cost of this Interconnector: Sum(MarginalValue x Factor) for all relevant Constraints, for Export (Factor >= 0)
fields.name: LOCAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_EXPORT

fields.doc: Key for Local_Price_Adjustment_Export: 2 = at least one Outage Constraint; 1 = at least 1 System Normal Constraint (and no Outage Constraint); 0 = No System Normal or Outage Constraints
